title: On Quantum Aspects of 1-Form Symmetries II: Bordism, Invertible Phases, and Anomalies
summary: We study quantum anomalies associated with $U(1)$ 1-form symmetries from the perspective of invertible phases and bordism. We compute the oriented and spin bordism groups of the Eilenberg-Mac Lane space $K(\mathbb{Z},3)$ up to degree 8 using the Atiyah-Hirzebruch spectral sequence, resolving the relevant extension problems by geometric arguments and identifying both bordism invariants and geometric generators.
